learning_outcomes.text: Know, understand and apply ecodesign concepts adapted to new situations for professional development.
Acquire environmental ethics concepts that allow an in-depth analysis of environmental issues that will affect engineers in their professional life.
Develop strategies and procedures for solving environmental problems of products and services.
Work in teams and develop knowledge with critical and responsible technical/cultural exchange.
Plan and manage ecodesign projects according to current legislation.
Critique product design from an ethical point of view.
Create industrial products and analyze their form and function from biomimetics.
Handle software for designing forms inspired by Nature.
Perform a life cycle analysis for an industrial product.

syllabus_topics: Topic ETI-01: Ethical and bioethical bases of ecological ethics.
Topic ETI-02: Ethical concerns in the ecological field: sustainability and ecological justice. Ethical concerns in the technological field.
Topic ETI-03: Paradigms to address the problems of ecological ethics in engineering: anthropocentrism, biocentrism, and ecofeminism.
Topic ACV-01: Regulations. Ecodesign management systems. ISO 14006.
Topic DIS-01: Business context. Motivating factors.
Topic DIS-04: Biomimetics and fractal geometry.
Topic DIS-06: Product simulation and evaluation.

assessment_methods.method: Reports and practical exercises from laboratory
Active participation in laboratory and classroom practices

assessment_rules: To pass, students must attend at least 80% of practical classes (classroom and laboratory). The final grade is calculated as 0.6 x EV1 + 0.3 x EV2 + 0.1 x EV3. If the established minimums are not met, the qualification will be the minimum between the calculated score and 4.0. For extraordinary evaluation, students must take a written test and submit an individual assignment, each weighted at 50%.
